Bias-correction matrix under complete randomization

Source: R/kernels.R
dot-bias_correction_matrix.Rd

Bias-correction matrix \(\hat M\) under cluster-level (stratified) complete randomization (Section 6.3, bias-corrected estimator): $$\hat M = \sum_{k : p_k \in (p_{overlap}, 1 - p_{overlap})} \hat s_k \hat s_k^\top / (|I_k| p_k (1 - p_k)),$$ $$\hat s_k = \sum_{(i,j)} (T_{ij,k} - m_{ij,k} p_k) V_{ij},$$ with \(T_{ij,k}\) the number of treated clusters of stratum k in \(N^{cl}_{ij}\), \(m_{ij,k}\) the number of clusters of stratum k in \(N^{cl}_{ij}\), and \(p_k\) the realised treated fraction of stratum k.

Usage

.bias_correction_matrix(A, C, W_C, V, strata = NULL, p_overlap = 0)

Arguments

A

n_unit x n_unit adjacency matrix (with self-loops).

C

integer vector of cluster ids.

W_C

0/1 vector of cluster-level treatments, indexed by cluster id.

V

n_unit x d contribution matrix.

strata

list of cluster-id vectors; NULL means one stratum.

p_overlap

strata with \(p_k\) outside \((p_{overlap}, 1 - p_{overlap})\) are skipped.

Value

A d x d PSD correction matrix.

Examples

set.seed(1)
A <- Matrix::Matrix(outer(1:12, 1:12, function(i, j) abs(i - j) <= 1) * 1,
                    sparse = TRUE)
C <- rep(1:4, each = 3)
W_C <- c(1, 0, 1, 0)  # exactly 2 of 4 clusters treated
V <- matrix(rnorm(12 * 2), 12, 2) / 12
generalClusterExp:::.bias_correction_matrix(A, C, W_C, V)
#>             [,1]         [,2]
#> [1,] 0.006504543 0.0010453082
#> [2,] 0.001045308 0.0001679855
